claim: Graphtreon's daily-updated Patreon Top 1000 shows that the platform's highest-earning creators are overwhelmingly long-tenured, with leading pages running 2,000 to 3,700 days (roughly 5.5 to 10 years), indicating that top-of-distribution creator income is a function of accumulated tenure rather than recent entry.
stance_target: The claim that top creator earnings accrue to long-surviving incumbents rather than to new entrants
scope_conditions: Patreon top 1000 creators only, accessed July 2026; extreme survivorship selection by construction — this is the surviving elite tail, not a cohort; launch dates cluster 2016-2020
quoted_support: Sortable list of Patreon top 1000 creators. Sort by clicking on the the top of each column. Filter by typing in the filter box. Updated daily.
numbers: Chapo Trap House 3,717 days running, launched May 2016

claim: Per-patron monthly revenue varies by roughly an order of magnitude among Patreon's largest creators, from $0.71-$0.72 for software-mod creators to $4.21-$6.21 for podcasts, so patron counts are a poor proxy for creator income.
stance_target: The claim that audience size is a weak predictor of creator earnings
scope_conditions: Patreon top-1000 creators only, accessed July 2026; publicly disclosed earnings only
quoted_support: Peter Boese ... 88,017 | $62,413 per month | $0.71 per month ... the yard ... 44,057 | $273,713 per month | $6.21 per month

claim: Chapo Trap House's Patreon earnings grew from $88,074 per month with 19,837 patrons in December 2017 to $195,369 per month with 46,397 patrons by July 2026, showing that established top-decile creators compound while the platform median stays near zero.
stance_target: The claim that creator earnings inequality widens over time rather than converging
scope_conditions: Single creator tracked across two observation points nearly nine years apart; 2017 figure from The Outline, 2026 figure from Graphtreon; nominal dollars, not inflation-adjusted
quoted_support: Chapo Trap House is Creating Chapo Trap House Podcast (chapotraphouse) | 46,397 | $195,369 per month | $4.21 per month | 3717 | May 2016

claim: Graphtreon publishes only a top-1000 ranking on its public creator page, so the full Patreon earnings distribution that underpinned the 2017 minimum-wage analysis is no longer straightforwardly reproducible from the public interface.
stance_target: The reproducibility of the widely-cited Patreon minimum-wage statistic
scope_conditions: graphtreon.com/patreon-creators accessed July 2026; audited absence — the site exposes category-filtered top-1000 lists but no aggregate distribution or total creator count on this page
quoted_support: Sortable list of Patreon top 1000 creators.
